title: Khaemenes Academic Core
description: Universal academic templates for planning, study, assessment, feedback, and reflection across subjects and grade levels.

templates.title: Assignment Brief
templates.description: A clear student-facing assignment framework with purpose, learning targets, evidence, process, permitted supports, success criteria, and submission details.

templates.title: Learning Goals Plan
templates.description: A learner-centered goal plan connecting current evidence, specific goals, success criteria, action steps, resources, checkpoints, and reflection.

templates.title: Exam Review Plan
templates.description: A structured assessment-review plan with scope, confidence tracking, study sessions, practice methods, error correction, and a final readiness check.
